interface.clock_reset: None: original interface has only in and state as inputs.

semantics.evidence: Original problem requests only the combinational state transition logic and Moore output logic.
semantics.timing: Combinational response to current inputs; no added cycle latency or storage.
semantics.initialization: No internal state or initialization specified; binary inputs determine outputs after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.

numeric.state_type: Unsigned 2-bit encoding; all four binary encodings are valid.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent literal eight-entry truth table derived from original problem.
verification.coverage: All eight input combinations, then all 64 ordered pairs of combinations to check response to input mutation and absence of retained outputs.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then sample after 1 ns of combinational settling; no clock edges are present in specification.
verification.failure: Case-inequality checks with $fatal, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original table specifies only binary states and in=0/1.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: X/Z behavior is outside specified functionality; oracle asserts only binary cases.
